about: All 5 DEV voice calls: p4-ru-002/004/005 labelled by Gemini (Pro) and reviewed (p4-ru-004 changed), p4-ru-001 and p4-ru-003 copied from the dev and held-out sets. 'uncertain' needs a human.

labels.notes: C1: company and name, no greeting word (a continuing call). C2: N/A, the need was known. C7: goodbye without help offer or summary.

C3: passed via SMS code after an address mismatch. C7: N/A, the client ended the call. Reviewed c6 10->4 and c4 20->15: the client asked three times whether he must write every time and the operator only repeated 'write or call'; the noise explains re-asking the e-mail, not this question.
C1: no operator name in the transcript. C3: N/A, registration question. C7: N/A, the client dropped the call.
Call. The first operator line greets and gives a name despite recognition errors. The client ended the call.
Client hung up the phone immediately after operator voiced the next step, leaving no time for goodbye, therefore c7 is N/A.
